title: sphaeralcea rivularis subsp. cismontana
intro: Sphaeralcea rivularis subsp. cismontana, commonly known as California globe mallow, is a flowering plant species in the family Malvaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe irritated skin and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of California globe mallow include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
